content.comment_body: Hello, I am attempting to insert an SVG image into a [product_name] web editor page by editing the main HTML file directly: . The image displays correctly in the editor, but when loading the actual device page, it shows as plain text. If I open the SVG directly in a browser, it works fine. Is there any way to use SVG files on a [product_name] with firmware [version_no]? Thank you, best regards, [user_name]

From my understanding, SVG images are not supported. The manual states: To add an image, select the Image component and drag it where you want in the editor. Note the size restriction: GIF files < 256 KB, PNG/JPG/JPEG < 2 MB. You can edit images in the Property pane and select options from the graph library.
Thank you for your quick response. I'll try your suggestion. It's unfortunate that SVG files aren't supported since they allow easy adaptation to different display sizes.
Doesn't this apply to PNG files as well...?

analysis.insight_summary: A user tried to add an SVG image in the [product_name] Web Editor by modifying the HTML, but found it only displays properly in the editor and not on the deployed device. Documentation and peer feedback confirm SVG is unsupported, and only GIF, PNG, JPG, or JPEG formats are permitted. This limitation makes it difficult for users who want scalable graphics that adjust well to different display sizes.
analysis.user_expectations: User anticipates that SVG format should be supported in the [product_name] Web Editor, allowing for flexible and scalable display across various devices.
